description: Header file defining fake remoting classes for testing media remoting functionality, including FakeRemotingDataStreamSender, FakeRemoter, and FakeRemoterFactory.

classes.name: FakeRemotingDataStreamSender
classes.description: A mock implementation of mojom::RemotingDataStreamSender for testing remoting data streams.

classes.name: FakeRemoter
classes.description: A mock implementation of mojom::Remoter for testing remoting control.

classes.name: FakeRemoterFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating FakeRemoter instances, with configurable start failure.

methods.name: FakeRemotingDataStreamSender
methods.description: Constructor initializing the data stream sender with a receiver and data pipe handle.

methods.name: ValidateFrameBuffer
methods.description: Validates the frame buffer at a given index with specified parameters.

methods.name: StartWithPermissionAlreadyGranted
methods.description: Starts remoting assuming permission is already granted.

methods.name: StartDataStreams
methods.description: Begins streaming audio and video data.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops remoting with a specified reason.

methods.name: SendMessageToSink
methods.description: Sends a message to the remoting sink.
